# Assumption of Moses Chapter 7 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Corrupt Rulers of the Last Days

---

**1** But after their punishment — in the time that follows their ruin — there will arise from among them men who are deceitful in times of peace.

**2** They will be self-serving, hypocritical in all their behavior, lovers of feasting at every hour of the day, gluttons and revelers.

**3** They will consume what belongs to the poor and afflicted.

**4** They will say: we have set royal tables.

**5** Their hands and minds will be occupied with impurity, and their mouths will utter great boasts.

**6** They will even say: do not touch me, lest you defile the high position I hold.

**7** And they will be deceitful, hating and speaking against one another.

**8** They will love luxury, take bribes, and have no justice in their dealings.

**9** They will consume the property of widows and of gentle men, saying: we are righteous.

**10** But in fact they will destroy the land, plundering the goods of the upright with wickedness and deceit.

**11** They will have no more wisdom than common men, and yet they will have the reputation of learned men.

**12** They will be puffed up with arrogance and will say: I am a lord, I sit upon a throne, and my glory takes precedence over all.
